paragraphs: Mentioned in Kiddushin 32a: Rav Yitzchak bar Shila said in the name of R' Matna, in the name of Rav Chisda.[^1]

notes.text: לב. gives Kiddushin 32a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. אר״י בר שילא is completed from the exact full heading Rav Yitzchak bar Shila. Matna’s א״ר contains an abbreviated title and remains R', without borrowing the heading’s Rav. Chisda’s Rav is full. The reporting order Yitzchak, Matna, Chisda is retained.
